verdict.rationale: Khoj's first-party docs describe Automations that run a user's query automatically at a scheduled time and frequency, then email the research results. This is a recurring, unattended background run, not a one-off action. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of automation setup, configuration options and triggers beyond time-based schedules, and independent or hands-on corroboration that automations run reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Automations allow you run your query automatically at a scheduled time and frequency. Khoj will send its research to you as an email.
Automations allow you run your query automatically at a scheduled time and frequency.
